target.unit: substantively distinct question candidates in a navigable atlas
target.notRequired: No person must answer the whole atlas; no claim it fits inside 120 hours.

budgetTemplates.meaning: Planning ceilings, not measured costs. The coordinator checks model context limits, sets a real run/spend ceiling and records actual usage. Workers use prepared packets without external tools. Fewer candidates are acceptable when the budget or meaningful coverage is exhausted.

hardFailures.rule: Invalid JSON, missing required keys, unknown prohibited keys or unresolved placeholders.
Question ID was not reserved, repeats an existing ID or references a nonexistent territory/domain/nearest-question ID.
Source ID, version or exact locator is absent from the packet or invented.
A new question is presented as a source quotation, or provisional topology is presented as settled source meaning.
The candidate supplies a personal answer, invents a participant fact or assumes an unreported experience/trait/condition.
Answering the candidate adds no substantive evidence or decision compared with an existing question; wording-only changes do not qualify.
The question requires personal disclosure without an alternative, treats refusal as diagnostic or ranks human worth.
Answering, reading or simulation is treated as consent, verified external fact, treatment completion or authority to act.
Mechanically generated combinations, rejected candidates or repeated words are represented as unique reviewed questions.

dimensions.score1: Relevant locus and labelled inference; one explanation needs tightening.
dimensions.score2: Exact locus supports the design connection and all interpretation limits are retained.

dimensions.score0: No identifiable understanding or decision sought.
dimensions.score1: A useful purpose is present but broad.
dimensions.score2: The answer can resolve a defined distinction, prediction, action or review gap.

dimensions.score1: Likely distinction, with nearest-neighbour comparison still needed.
dimensions.score2: Explains how the answer adds evidence or decision value beyond the nearest questions.

dimensions.score0: Timeless trait assumption or unsupported universal sequence.
dimensions.score1: Some condition, episode or scope is visible.
dimensions.score2: The relevant conditions and information states are explicit without inventing participant facts.

dimensions.score0: Vague, self-contradictory or demands inaccessible knowledge.
dimensions.score1: Understandable but could be narrower or better scoped.
dimensions.score2: A person can answer with an episode, uncertainty, practical record or chosen fictional example.

dimensions.score0: No plausible use for the answer.
dimensions.score1: A reasonable reflection or action connection is present.
dimensions.score2: The answer has an explicit role in a model revision, experiment, skill, relationship or artefact.

dimensions.score0: Coercive, leading or equates disclosure with worth.
dimensions.score1: Optionality is present but could be clearer.
dimensions.score2: Personal meaning, decline, uncertainty and alternative routes remain available.

dimensions.score0: Jargon or nested tasks obscure the question.
dimensions.score1: Readable with a minor wording or complexity issue.
dimensions.score2: Plain, precise wording; any complexity serves one coherent inquiry.

duplicateTriage.thresholdStatus: Uncalibrated starting triage values; calibrate on labelled project pairs before use. Never reject solely on similarity.
duplicateTriage.searchScope: Global catalogue, including neighbouring and cross-domain questions
duplicateTriage.mergeRule: Pure paraphrases become alternate wordings/navigation links of one question. Prediction and actual-outcome review can remain distinct when they elicit different evidence.

sampling.sampledHardFailure: Hold the batch and inspect it fully.
sampling.triggerAction: Revise the packet and return the territory to full inspection for the next two batches.
sampling.claimBoundary: Sampling is not proof of flawlessness; record precisely which questions received human review.

states.implementationNote: These richer categories guide metadata design. Current runtime enforces generated plus explicit accepted/needs_revision/rejected states and separate answer references, not all proposed publication fields.

escalation: A source region supports incompatible meanings with different downstream consequences.
A question needs a participant-specific fact or permission absent from the packet.
Critic and reconciler remain in substantive disagreement after two cycles.
A corrected source interpretation affects already published questions or answered records.
A territory's batch repeatedly fails novelty or evidence checks despite packet revision.

hyperMode.rule: Content throughput only. Reflection, answers, silence, action and pauses have separate actual time. 2x playback is a means to the delivered rate, not an additional multiplier.

pilot.inspection: Full pilot inspection; no claim the production-scale target is already generated.

runtimeContract.dimensionAuthority: Exact enums in the selected runtime packet from data/weaving-atlas.json
runtimeContract.sourceBoundary: Current packets include curated summaries and locators, not complete primary-source passages. SourceNotes must state this limit.
runtimeContract.stateBoundary: Import creates generated records only. Explicit reviewer operation sets accepted/needs_revision/rejected. No review or answer field is permitted in generator output.
runtimeContract.implementedChecks: Strict shape, reserved IDs, enums, allowed source IDs, open premises, no answers, exact normalised duplicates, token-overlap warnings. Semantic/source support and richer review protocol are separate.

metadataPlacement.rubricScoresAndReview: separate critic/reconciler sidecar; never generator self-approval
